task: Add a learning_scan CLI that derives finding-signals through the store ports and persists them to .lattice/learning/finding-signals.json, activating the previously-inert Phase 1.5 advisory review hints.
outcome:
Running `node bin/lattice.js learning_scan` derives the finding-signals and writes the cache, printing a summary the operator can read, for example:

  learning_scan: derived 31 signal(s) over 402 story scan
    wrote .lattice/learning/finding-signals.json (schemaVersion 1, updatedAt 2026-06-18T01:30:00.000Z)
  (advisory learning cache — materialHash-excluded; no gate touched)

With --json it prints { written, path, signals, updatedAt }. The decisive observable effect: BEFORE the scan the experience-hint loader returns no hints (empty cache); AFTER the scan, for a story whose findings match accumulated signals, the loader returns a non-empty 'Project experience hints (advisory only)' section — i.e. hints now actually fire.
facts: deriveFindingSignalsFromStore(store, opts) persists the cache via writeFindingSignals when opts.projectRoot is provided (finding-signals.ts ~line 282-283); learning_validate (B-a2e3) deliberately omits projectRoot to stay read-only.

writeFindingSignals and readFindingSignals both target .lattice/learning/finding-signals.json (learning-store.ts is the ONLY toucher of .lattice/learning/); experience-hint-loader.ts reads it via readFindingSignals(projectRoot).
.lattice/learning/ is materialHash-EXCLUDED (prefix matcher), so writing the cache never perturbs any gate or evidence freshness.
The derived cache now carries anchorFiles (B-a2e3), so the hint loader / future effectiveness metric can re-validate at read time via revalidateSignals.

Adding a new command requires an entry in core/process-fact-levels.ts PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS (the derive-source for COMMAND_PROCESS_FACTS / PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY); otherwise the process-fact-contract suite in `npm test` fails (lesson from B-a2e3).

learning_scan WRITES the advisory cache, so it is an experience-layer mutation (process-fact level L2, like signature_registry_set/playbook_propose) — NOT read-only, and NOT added to READ_ONLY_COMMANDS.
constraints: Reads findings only via store ports; the ONLY write is the advisory learning cache; files no findings; touches no gate; changes no scoring/promptHash.
No referential-staleness filtering at scan time (the cache is a faithful snapshot; filtering stays at read time).
Deterministic given a pinned now: re-running on the same store yields an equivalent cache.
No signatureTag capture (story 3.2), no A/B gating (3.3), no effectiveness metric (3.4).
unknowns: Whether learning_scan should be allowed in all phases or a subset — resolved: allow broadly (it is an out-of-band maintenance command writing only the advisory cache), matching how signature_registry_set/playbook_* are phase-gated.
The exact project-root the handler should pass — resolved: use the same root the store/handler context exposes (ctx.projectRoot if present, else process.cwd()), consistent with other handlers.
